analysis: The PR changes only CHANGELOG.md: the v0.10.12 candidate header is replaced by a v0.10.13 candidate section (head lines 11-41) and v0.10.12 becomes a published section. No source, protocol, crypto, attestation, authorization or coordinator code is in this batch, so no executable control is added, removed or weakened. Changelog-described behaviors are untested here: (1) a Gemma 4 loop-guard exit that closes the thought channel and continues generation in the same response, with DARKBLOOM_LOOP_EXIT_THINKING and DARKBLOOM_LOOP_GUARD now passed through launchd (head lines 25, 41); (2) the cluster-setup stop counter exposed in the leading Mac's status, with the joining Mac ending only on a stop asked since the start began, and an older leader sending no count (lines 26, 33-34). Both are descriptions only, and no implementation is supplied. The 'Stopped' status and stop-counter semantics touch A-018 availability and the cluster/pair paths; the changelog says stops arrive via darkbloom cluster stop, stop or restart, which are local operator actions, but I cannot verify authorization or whether a remote peer can forge the counter or the stop signal. The loop-exit continuation is a new generation path that must keep the same encryption of responses (T-008) and prompt-cache handling (T-041); the changelog gives no evidence either way, so the next pass should examine the actual code if it is in another batch. No threat-model entries are invalidated by the text itself. Documentation-only change; no findings.
